ink.$description: Carbon Ink. Primary text, dark sections, app headers, primary dark buttons.

ink-raised.$description: Raised surfaces on Carbon Ink (cards, inputs on dark).

citrus.$description: Electric Citrus. Signature accent: primary CTA fill, selected states, highlights. NEVER as text on light surfaces (1.1:1). Text on citrus is always ink (14:1).

accent-ink.$description: Citrus-family text colour for rare accents on light surfaces (5.3:1 on porcelain).

olive.$description: Soft Olive. Decorative details, dividers, icons on light. As TEXT only on ink (5.9:1).

stone.$description: Warm Stone. Subtle fills: icon tiles, chips, image placeholders.

card.$description: Service cards, sheets, inputs, product surfaces.

secondary.$description: AA on porcelain (5.6), white (6.3) and stone (5.2).

inverse-secondary.$description: White at 70% for body text on ink.

inverse.$description: White at 12% for dividers on ink.
